data.name: Ruwaid
data.gender_notes: Ruwaid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ruwaid is an Arabic name that signifies a companion or friend who accompanies one on a journey. It is a name that symbolizes loyalty and camaraderie. The name Ruwaid carries the meaning “Companion in the journey” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ruwaid usually hope their child will grow to embody companion in the journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Ruwaid is reminiscent of the Prophet's companions who stood by him during his journey.
data.etymology: Ruwaid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion in the journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruwaid total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رويد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رويد مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-و-د' والذي يعني السير البطيء والهادئ. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لوصف الشخص الذي يتحرك بحكمة وروية في أفعاله. كما ورد في بعض التفاسير أن رويد يمكن أن يعني الرفق واللين في التعامل مع الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: روید
in_urdu.meaning: روید کا مطلب ہے سیر سست اور پرسکون
in_urdu.long_meaning: روید نام عربی جڑ 'ر-و-د' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سیر سست اور پرسکون۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے کاموں میں حکمت اور رویا کے ساتھ چلتا ہے۔ بعض تفاسیر میں روید کا مطلب دوسروں کے ساتھ معاملات میں رفق اور لین دین بھی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रवैद
in_hindi.meaning: रवैद का अर्थ है धीमी और शांत गति
in_hindi.long_meaning: रवैद नाम अरबी जड़ 'र-व-द' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है धीमी और शांत गति। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने कार्यों में बुद्धिमत्ता और विचार के साथ चलता है। कुछ व्याख्याओं में रवैद का अर्थ दूसरों के साथ व्यवहार में कोमलता और शालीनता भी है।

in_pashto.name: رويد
in_pashto.meaning: رويد معنی سست او ارام چالۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: رويد نوم د عربي ريښې 'ر-و-د' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې معنی يې د سست او ارام چالۍ څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په کې د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي کوم چې په خپلو کړو وړو کې د حکمت او راوی سره ګام اخلي. په ځینو تفسیرو کې رويد د نورو سره د چلند په معاملو کې د رفق او نرمۍ معنی هم لري.

in_english.name: Ruwaid
in_english.meaning: Slow and peaceful walking, gentle and kind
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ruwaid is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-و-د' (R-W-D), which signifies slow and peaceful walking. In Islamic tradition, Ruwaid is used to describe an individual who conducts themselves with wisdom and caution. Etymologically linked to concepts of gentleness and kindness, Ruwaid connotes a person who interacts with others softly and courteously. Historically, the name reflects a value placed on measured and thoughtful action in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruwaid holds significant cultural importance in the Arab world and the broader Muslim community. In traditional Arab society, the concept of companionship and brotherhood holds great value. Ruwaid as a name is a tribute to this cultural ideal. It is a reminder of the importance of standing by your friends and loved ones during times of struggle, and the value of loyalty and companionship in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ruwaid carries a deeper meaning. In the Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his followers are often referred to as the "Companions" of the Prophet. The term "Rashidun Caliphs" refers to the first four rightly-guided caliphs who succeeded the Prophet Muhammad. These companions were trusted advisors, companions, and friends of the Prophet, and they played a crucial role in the spread of Islam and the establishment of the early Islamic state.
